entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Darwin Harrikson Cubillán Salom [coo-be-yahn' / sah-lom'] is a Venezuelan former professional baseball right-handed relief pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Toronto Blue Jays, Texas Rangers, Montreal Expos, and Baltimore Orioles. He also played in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Hanshin Tigers, and in the KBO League for the SK Wyverns.
